components_meaning: Signed exact symmetric target decomposition plus previous-realized price drift; absolute components may offset and must not be costed separately
categories_meaning: Actual trade amount grouped by sign change, same-sign amplitude, or paid boundary; groups are descriptive, never oracle causal return attribution
scale_fact: All fixed-reference weights, gross, drift-turnover and BASE27 costs are degree1 homogeneous for positive uniform rescaling. Shrinking/expanding positions alone cannot change signed margin or break-even rate. This is an algebraic fact, no rescaled strategy evaluated. Native minimum/rounding/risk would break homogeneity and remain unmeasured.
